notes: The fraction content is correct (cut into 3 or 4 equal parts, cut at 1/3, 2/3, 1/4, 1/2) and it targets the equal-parts mix-up. Wave 3's labels do not match its items: the title is "Spot the whole" and the sub is "Teen equal pieces yaad rakho", but it includes a {"parts": 4} item. This is a mismatch rather than a wrong fact, so I did not count it.

faults.detail: The sub says "4 marks ka matlab 5 gaps hai", but the wave sets "ticks": 5 and "scaffoldTicks": 6. The other waves follow ticks = marks inside 0-1 (ticks 1 → 2 gaps, 3 → 4, 4 → 5), so this line has 5 marks and 6 gaps. The text tells the child something false about the line in front of them, and neither item ("1/5", "1/4") falls on a mark of that line.

faults.where: first screen at every size, falling "1/2" pod
faults.detail: A guide line drops from the lower "1/2" pod straight to the middle of the 0-1 line (l1366: line runs from x≈306 to x≈1259, pointer lands at ≈783), so the screen shows where 1/2 goes before the child places it.
"W वही jagah": a Devanagari word inside an otherwise Roman-script Hinglish piece, plus a stray "W".

notes: Waves 1-3 are correct and fit the mix-up of counting marks instead of gaps (1/2 with 1 mark, 1/4 with 3 marks, 3/5 with 4 marks). On the first screen I could not see the middle tick that "ticks": 1 implies, but that may be how the engine shows ticks, so I did not count it.

faults.detail: The card "Round 1/4  Stake exactly 40 sq units" sits over the top edge of the grid and touches the AREA/PERIMETER/ROUND pills. It also covers the coach line "Grid par plot banao", which shows only as blurred text behind the card.

faults.where: on-screen goal text at all sizes
faults.detail: "Stake exactly 40 sq units": "stake" is not a plain word for a class 6 child, and this English sentence does not match the piece's Hinglish strings ("Grid par plot banao", "sabse zyada area").

notes: The targets work on the 15x10 grid (area 40, perimeter 26, perimeter 28), and the area-40 round followed by a different perimeter-26 shape works against the area/perimeter mix-up. The last round, "maxArea" with target 40 ("sabse zyada area"), does not say what limit applies: if it is perimeter 26, the true maximum is 42 (6x7). I cannot tell the limit from the spec, so I did not count it.
